scenes.title: Consumer Finance Apps
scenes.text: Let me show you Runway, built for the Consumer Finance track. When you freelance for stablecoins, a late invoice can leave rent uncovered, even when your expected income looks healthy.

scenes.title: Signed Sui wallet
scenes.text: I am connecting the supplied Sui wallet and signing Runway’s login message. This opens a private workspace. The signature does not transfer funds.

scenes.title: Live Tatum balance
scenes.text: Here I refresh the wallet through Tatum on Sui Mainnet. This is the actual balance, separate from the example we are about to run.

scenes.title: A late invoice, a fixed bill
scenes.text: Now let’s open the labelled example. Eight hundred USDC is confirmed. Twelve hundred is still expected. We have a Saturday purchase, Monday rent, and a hundred USDC reserve.

scenes.title: A promise is not cash
scenes.text: On the client’s promised Friday, the projection covers rent. But an unpaid invoice is still a promise. It never increases the money available now.

scenes.title: History changes the decision
scenes.text: Switch to past payments. Four invoices arrived three, four, four, and five days late. That moves Friday to Tuesday, after rent. The smallest permitted fix is reducing the flexible purchase by a hundred and fifty USDC.

scenes.title: An inspectable reason
scenes.text: Here is the evidence behind that decision: which past payments were used, the observed range, and the median delay. You can inspect the reason before accepting the plan.

scenes.title: Protect rent and the reserve
scenes.text: The no-payment stress test checks the downside too. I review the change: the purchase drops from two hundred and fifty to one hundred. Rent stays fixed.

scenes.title: Save and return
scenes.text: I save the plan and reload. The change survives. We have preserved the reserve without treating expected income as cash, and without moving any funds.

scenes.title: Recall from Walrus, live
scenes.text: Now I click Recall from Walrus. This makes a real Mainnet request for the published synthetic records. Their identifiers and content hashes must match. The recalled history reproduces the same hundred-and-fifty USDC decision.

scenes.title: Remember corrections too
scenes.text: Memory must also remember corrections. The recalled reserve update changes the reduction to one hundred USDC. A separate client correction removes the wrong payment from that history, so an old fact cannot quietly drive the next forecast.

scenes.title: A finance decision you can keep
scenes.text: This is the Consumer Finance idea: separate cash from promises, protect bills before a late payment, and carry payment lessons between sessions. The replay publishes its misses too. Runway gives freelancers a decision they can inspect, review, and keep.
